job.title: Cyber Security Lead
job.description:
Cyber Security & IT Lead 

We’re looking for an experienced Cyber Security Lead to take ownership of cyber security and IT operations across a growing national brand with big plans!!
Reporting directly to the CTO, this is a hands-on role with genuine influence and visibility across the business. You’ll own the security space, help shape our IT environment, and play a key role in how we safely adopt AI.
What you’ll be doing
  • Own and mature the cyber security program, aligned to Essential Eight and ISO 27001 principles.
  • Manage our Microsoft security stack across Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Purview and Conditional Access.
  • Own identity, access, incident response and security awareness.
  • Lead security reporting, risk management and relationships with external security partners.
  • Provide hands-on IT leadership across Microsoft 365, endpoints, networks and collaboration tools.
  • Support technology migrations and consolidation across both businesses.
  • Help establish safe and effective AI usage and security practices.
What we’re looking for
  • 5+ years’ experience in a hands-on security or security-focused IT role.
  • Strong Microsoft 365 security and Essential Eight knowledge.
  • Solid understanding of identity, MFA, privileged access and least privilege.
  • A pragmatic, risk-based approach — focused on real security, not compliance theatre.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Someone who actively uses AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot to work smarter.
Why join us?
  • Direct access to the CTO and executive team.
  • Genuine ownership of cyber security across a growing Australian brand.
  • Modern Microsoft-first technology environment.
  • An AI-forward culture with the tools and freedom to innovate.
  • Hybrid working and a supportive team.
If you’re looking for a role where you can own security, influence technology decisions and make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Senior HR Systems Consultant
job.description:
• $850-$1000 per day 
  • 6 month contract
  • Hybrid role / Redfern Location 
About the role
This Global client  is currently undertaking a significant HRIS transformation, and we're looking for an experienced Senior HR Systems Consultant to join the People & Culture team on a 6-month contract.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an HR Systems professional who enjoys taking systems from design and configuration through testing, implementation and go-live.

You'll work closely with People & Culture, Technology and key business stakeholders to ensure the new HR platform delivers a great experience for employees and managers, while integrating effectively with the wider technology environment.

What you'll be doing
  • Configure and build HR system solutions from agreed designs
  • Lead UAT, including test planning, scripts, test data, defect management and business sign-off
  • Assess the impact of system and process changes across payroll, finance, reporting and other connected systems
  • Coordinate integration and regression testing
  • Develop and deliver stakeholder communications, training and change activities
  • Support go-live, hypercare and continuous improvement
  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes and reduce manual workarounds
  • Support the decommissioning of the existing HR platform and secure retention of employee data
  • Partner with P&C, Technology and business stakeholders to deliver successful outcomes
About you
You'll have:
  • 5+ years' experience implementing, configuring or supporting HR/People systems
  • Strong hands-on HRIS configuration and implementation experience
  • Proven experience with UAT, testing and defect management
  • Experience taking systems through go-live and stabilisation
  • Strong understanding of HR processes across the employee lifecycle
  • Experience working with system integrations and downstream data flows
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
  • The ability to influence and collaborate across a matrix environment
  • A practical, solutions-focused approach and strong attention to detail
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, globally distributed organisation
Why join?
This is an opportunity to play a key role in a significant HR technology transformation, working across People & Culture, Technology and the wider business.

You'll have the opportunity to make a genuine impact on how employees and people leaders interact with the people systems.

6-month contract | Full-time | Hybrid

job.title: Managing Director
job.description:
Managing Director – Managed IT Services

Melbourne | Hybrid | $225,000 + super + up to $50,000 bonus | Equity opportunity

Run it. Grow it. Own the outcome.

We're looking for a commercially driven Managing Director to take full ownership of an established and profitable Managed IT Services business.
This is a genuine MD role. Reporting directly to the CEO of the parent group, you'll own the strategy, P&L, clients, team, go-to-market and growth plan. There is no layer of management between you and the owner, and you'll have the autonomy to make the decisions.

The ambition is significant: grow the business and triple revenue and EBITDA.
What you'll inherit
  • Established, profitable MSP with a loyal client base
  • Six-person engineering team, including three senior engineers
  • Strong culture and mature service delivery, SLAs and tooling
  • Finance and marketing support from the wider group
  • AI and automation already deployed across the business
  • Access to genuine cyber security expertise through the parent group
  • A new brand launching ahead of your arrival
  • Investment available behind a credible growth strategy
  
You'll be responsible for:
  • Building and executing the growth strategy
  • Personally developing pipeline and winning new MSP clients
  • Owning the P&L, pricing, margins and profitability
  • Developing the proposition and route to market
  • Growing revenue across the existing client base
  • Leading the engineering team and service delivery
  • Building referral, partner and marketing channels
  • Strengthening processes, automation and operational performance
  • Owning senior client relationships and major issues
What we are looking for:
We're looking for someone who has personally grown a business or significant revenue line and can demonstrate the numbers.
You'll need:
  • A proven track record of revenue growth
  • Ideally experience within an MSP
  • Strong personal sales and business development capability
  • Experience building and executing go-to-market strategy
  • P&L and commercial ownership
  • Strong leadership and operational skills
  • A hands-on, entrepreneurial mindset
  • Confidence working autonomously and wearing multiple hats
  • A genuine interest in using AI and automation to improve how a business operates
An MSP or technology services background is highly desirable. Technical knowledge across Microsoft, Azure, networking, security and related services is beneficial, but commercial capability comes first.

job.title: Head of Business Systems - QSR
job.description:
Our client is looking for an experienced Head of Business Systems to take ownership of the technology platforms, applications and systems that support their Central Support environment and Network.

This is a unique opportunity for a technically capable leader who enjoys being both strategic and hands-on. You’ll shape the IT strategy and governance framework for the organisation while remaining close to the technology, solving complex problems, leading system improvements and supporting the business when it matters most.
Reporting directly to the Managing Director and leading a small team, you’ll play a key role in ensuring technology is a true enabler of business performance, innovation and growth.
The Role As Head of Business Systems, you will lead the strategic direction, management and support of the organisation's business applications and technology ecosystem.
You’ll balance leadership responsibilities with hands on technical involvement, including troubleshooting complex issues, managing vendors, overseeing system enhancements and ensuring the ongoing stability and performance of critical platforms.

Key responsibilities will include:
  • Leading the management, support and strategic direction of business applications across the organisation.
  • Managing and developing the Business Systems Support function and ensuring high standards of service delivery.
  • Maintaining the performance, stability and availability of critical business systems.
  • Leading complex troubleshooting and root cause analysis while establishing preventative frameworks.
  • Overseeing testing, change management and the successful delivery of system enhancements.
  • Driving system optimisation, process improvement and technology initiatives that deliver measurable business value.
  • Establishing strong documentation, governance, knowledge management and business continuity practices.
  • Managing key technology vendors, including POS Systems, covering relationships, SLAs, escalations and contract negotiations.
  • Providing leadership and hands-on administration across core platforms including Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.
  • Building strong relationships with business stakeholders, technology partners and vendors.
The role is responsible for delivering both strategic technology outcomes and practical day-to-day support across a fast-paced, multi-site environment.

What we are looking for :
  • 5–10 years' experience across business systems, application support, deployments and enterprise application management.
  • Experience leading business systems or IT support functions in complex operational environments.
  • Experience working within a QSR technology team
  • Experience within retail, hospitality, franchise or other multi-site operational environments will be highly regarded.
  • At least 3 years' experience in IT project management and business analysis, with a track record of delivering technology initiatives successfully.
  • Experience with Microsoft technologies, including Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.
  • A practical understanding of AI and its application to business systems and process improvement.
  • Experience working with enterprise software platforms, digital content management and modern technology ecosystems.
  • A solid understanding of APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, web-services architecture and enterprise monitoring tools.
  • Strong vendor and product management experience, including contract negotiations and SLA management.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and root cause analysis capabilities.
  • The ability to translate technical concepts into clear business outcomes and value.
  • Outstanding stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • A genuine customer service mindset and a passion for building practical, solutions-focused technology teams.

job.title: Account Manager/ BDM
job.description:
Pathfinder Recruitment is excited to bring to market a great opportunity for a dynamic Account Manager/ BDM to join a Central Coast based MSP. Providing innovative managed IT services tailored to small and mid-market businesses, their mission is to help businesses thrive by delivering exceptional IT solutions that drive success. If you are a highly motivated, client-focused Account Manager / Business Development Manager (AM/BDM), this role will see you play a crucial role in nurturing existing client relationships and driving new business opportunities. 
 
About the role: 
This hybrid role combines Account Management (80%) and Business Development (20%) responsibilities. The primary focus will be on maintaining and growing existing client relationships to ensure satisfaction, retention, and account growth, while also identifying and securing new business opportunities aligned with the company’s strategic growth objectives. As the key liaison between clients, prospects, and internal teams, you'll ensure delivery excellence and uncover solutions that add business value. 
 
Key Responsibilities: 
Client Account Management (80%): 
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for an assigned portfolio of clients. 
  • Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships based on trust and value. 
  • Conduct regular account management meetings and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) to ensure client satisfaction and uncover new needs. 
  • Understand client business goals and align IT strategies to support them effectively. 
  • Monitor service delivery performance and proactively address issues to ensure high standards. 
  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within the existing client base. 
  • Manage agreement renewals and oversee the client contract lifecycle. 
  • Ensure accurate and up-to-date client information in CRM/PSA systems. 
  • Collaborate with technical teams to scope, quote, and deliver tailored IT solutions that meet client needs. 
  
New Business Development (20%): 
  • Identify and prospect new business opportunities within the SMB and mid-market segments. 
  • Build and maintain a small pipeline of qualified leads through referrals, networking, and outbound activity. 
  • Conduct introductory meetings, needs assessments, and present tailored Managed Service Provider (MSP) solutions to prospective clients. 
  • Prepare and deliver compelling proposals for new clients. 
  • Handover won accounts to the onboarding and technical teams for a smooth transition into service delivery. 
 
 
Key Skills: 
  • Proven experience in Account Management, Sales, or Business Development, preferably within an IT services or MSP environment. 
  • Strong client relationship management skills with a demonstrated ability to build and sustain long-term partnerships. 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage clients at various levels. 
  • Experience in identifying business opportunities and growing client portfolios. 
  • Familiarity with CRM/PSA systems to track and manage client information. 
  • Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment. 
  • Self-motivated with strong time-management skills and the ability to handle multiple priorities effectively. 
  • Industry certifications (e.g., ITIL, CompTIA, Microsoft, etc.) are a plus.  
Ready to chat? 
If you're a proactive, solution-driven professional with a passion for client success and business growth, please apply and we will be in touch!
